name: @pm/db
description: persistent-memory data layer — the two Prisma 7 clients (prisma=pm_app data / ownerPrisma=pmuser owner), the runInTenant() RLS tx wrapper, the audit guard (guardedPrisma), and the AsyncLocalStorage tenant context. Consumed by api AND worker. Owns the generated-client import; callers never touch generated/prisma directly. The two connection strings are INJECTED via initDb() so @pm/db depends on no app-specific config module.
